sheets.name: NAND Flash
rows: Data inputs/outputs: The bidirectional I/Os transfer address, data, and command infor_x0002_mation.

Ready/busy: An open-drain, active-low output that requires an external pull-up resistor.
This signal indicates target array activity.
Read enable: Transfers serial data from the NAND Flash to the host system.

Write enable: Transfers commands, addresses, and serial data from the host system to the
NAND Flash.
EMIF无匹配信号，分配一般GPIO作为控制信号
Address latch enable: Loads an address from I/O[7:0] into the address register.
Chip enable: Enables or disables one or more die (LUNs) in a target.
EMIF无匹配信号，分配一般GPIO作为控制信号
Command latch enable: Loads a command from I/O[7:0] into the command register.
EMIF无匹配信号，分配一般GPIO作为控制信号
Write protect: Enables or disables array PROGRAM and ERAS_nE operations.

Reset: Active LOW input. RST# resets internal automation and inhibits WRITE operations.
This provides data protection during power transitions. RST# HIGH enables normal opera_x0002_tion. Exit from reset places the device in asynchronous read array mode.
EMIF无匹配信号，分配一般GPIO作为控制信号

Write protect: Active LOW input. WP# LOW enables the lock-down mechanism. Blocks in
lock-down cannot be unlocked with the Unlock command. WP# HIGH overrides the lock_x0002_down function enabling blocks to be eRAS_ned or programmed using software commands.
Note: Designs not using WP# for protection could tie it to VCCQ or VSS without additional
capacitor.
